# CFO Brief: H1 2026 Close (for investor meeting)

Prepared from `finance/ledger.csv`, `finance/chart_of_accounts.csv`, `finance/cash_balance.txt`, `finance/README.md`. All figures in BRL.

## Monthly P&L

| Month | Revenue | COGS | Gross margin | Opex (5.x) | Financial (6.x) | EBITDA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Jan | 200,510.87 | -60,091.92 | 70.03% | -350,697.91 | +6,466.77 | **-210,278.96** |
| Feb | 216,328.06 | -64,278.71 | 70.29% | -364,349.43 | +7,298.39 | **-212,300.08** |
| Mar | 219,066.17 | -69,096.05 | 68.46% | -354,495.57 | +6,446.51 | **-204,525.45** |
| Apr | 238,163.26 | -70,867.73 | 70.24% | -364,246.18 | +7,280.37 | **-196,950.65** |
| May | 243,032.89 | -73,973.13 | 69.56% | -371,005.58 | +6,501.04 | **-201,945.82** |
| Jun | 272,391.57 | -75,162.69 | 72.41% | -390,197.10 | +5,621.65 | **-192,968.22** |

H1 totals: revenue 1,389,492.82; EBITDA -1,218,969.18.

## The story
- Revenue grew every single month: +35.8% Jan→Jun (200.5k → 272.4k), ~9.4% average monthly growth.
- Gross margin stable at ~68-70% and stepped up to 72.4% in June.
- EBITDA loss narrowed from -212.3k (Feb) to -193.0k (Jun): losses improving even while investing in sales/engineering. The board's narrative is credible: growth with controlled burn.
- Refunds to customer Kestrel hit Mar (-6,814.15) and May (-8,634.37) and are already netted in revenue (account 3.1.09).

## Cash and runway
- Closing cash 30/06/2026: **R$ 1,847,350.40** (per cash_balance.txt).
- Burn (per board's definition in README: average monthly negative EBITDA of the last three closed months, Apr-Jun): (196,950.65 + 201,945.82 + 192,968.22) / 3 = **R$ 197,288.23 / month**.
- Runway = 1,847,350.40 / 197,288.23 = **9.4 months** (about 9 months and 11 days, i.e. cash into late March 2027 at current burn).
- Cross-check: cash fell 461,837.60 from 31/05 to 30/06 vs June EBITDA of -192,968.22; the difference is working-capital/payment timing, since the ledger covers P&L entries only. This does not affect the board-defined runway.

## Assumptions
1. EBITDA = revenue (3.x) + COGS (4.x) + opex (5.x), excluding financial income/expenses (6.x) per standard EBITDA definition. Including 6.x would change monthly EBITDA by ~+5.6k to +7.3k and burn to 190,895.09, runway to 9.68 months - not material to the message.
2. Gross margin = (revenue + COGS) / revenue, with refunds (3.1.09) netted in revenue.
3. Burn and runway follow exactly the definitions in finance/README.md.
4. Ledger amounts use Brazilian number format (dot thousands, comma decimal); parsed accordingly.
5. Amounts are P&L-recognized, not cash-flow; runway uses the board's EBITDA-based definition rather than a cash-flow burn.
